If you're also defecting, we both get $1 instead of the $0/$5 split risk. Want to confirm we're both defecting so neither of us gets burned?

So yes, I'll be defecting this round. No hard feelings — it's just the equilibrium outcome given the payoff structure and our lack of future accountability. Confirmed: DEFECT.
